command.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.rank: Ranger’s Trail completed up to rank %s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_arrow_rain.des: Half a second after the hit, 10 spectral arrows (+3 per Amplify) rain down in a 3-block circle. Each arrow deals 1.6; each enemy takes at most 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_bullet_line.de: Form (Ranger origin; a tribute to the virtual-game sniper). Aims with the red BULLET LINE (the target sees it!) for 0.8 s (Accelerate shortens it) and the shot fires instantly, never missing: it hits the target wherever it is, unless a block is in the way. +2% power per block of distance (up to ×2); Pierce goes through enemies on the line; Split locks onto more targets (per-copy cost). Range 96.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_chain_arrow.de: After the hit, spectral arrows leap to up to 3 nearby enemies (+1 per Amplify), each jump dealing 80% of the previous one.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_conjured_chain: Effect (Ranger origin; a tribute to the chain hunter). On an enemy: PRISON — 4 damage, held in place by a chain for 5 s (Extend), slowed and unable to teleport, Rooted and Silenced for a moment — and THEFT: takes 1 good effect (+1 per Amplify) and gives it to you; steals 10% mana from players. On you or an ally: HOLY CHAIN — heals 6 and clears 2 bad effects (+1 per Amplify).
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_explosive_arro: The tip detonates on hitting a creature or the ground: area damage (5) that falls off with distance plus knockback, without breaking blocks. Expand widens the blast.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_hunters_mark.d: Deals a little damage and marks the target for 12 s: it glows through walls and takes +25% damage from you and your companions (+10% per Amplify). Companions hunt marked prey first.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_net_arrow.desc: Unfolds an enchanted net: the target and anyone nearby are rooted and slowed; flyers are dragged to the ground. It also sets the net where it hits the ground.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_pack_call.desc: On yourself: summons the Wolf (and the Eagle, from Trail rank I), heals 30% and grants Regeneration. On an enemy: your companions appear and attack it with Strength and Speed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_piercing_arrow: A heavy blow (6.5) that leaves the target Exposed and punches through: anyone behind it on the line of fire (10 blocks) takes 70%.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_quickdraw.desc: Augment: +2 arrows in a fan and more speed, each one weaker (pays the per-copy cost).
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_sacred_arrow.d: Arrow effect (Ranger origin; a tribute to the priestess archer who crossed the well of time). Pink light that PURIFIES: 7 Light damage; impure creatures (undead, Corrupted) take ×2.5, catch fire and lose every good effect. On impact, a purification wave (radius 3, Expand) clears bad effects from allies and heals a little. On you or an ally: purifies and heals.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_seeking.desc: Augment: the arrow chases the nearest enemy, flies faster and can land critical hits.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_steed_call.des: On yourself: the Ranger’s Steed appears saddled and you mount it (while riding: a gallop with Speed and Jump Boost). On an enemy: the Steed charges, hurting and knocking back everything on its path.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_thousand_feath: G form (ultimate): a giant Spirit Eagle circles the area while 30 + 4×Circle arrows rain down (effects at 35%); at the end it dives and the effects strike the center at full power.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_triple_shot.de: Form (Ranger origin; a tribute to the elven archer who shoots while running and leaping). Three quick volleys of magic arrows (no arrows spent), each one aiming ON ITS OWN at a different enemy ahead (40° cone, 32 blocks). While moving — sprinting, airborne or mounted — each volley has +25% power, and in the air you float down to keep shooting. Split adds arrows to each volley (per-copy cost).
glyph.isekai_mahou.ranger_wolf_god.desc: Effect (Ranger origin, rank V; a tribute to the giant forest wolf). Your Wolf (called if needed) awakens as the divine beast: white, GIANT (×2.5), +80 health, +14 area bites, armor and speed; howls every 5 s to terrify enemies and grants you Regeneration nearby. 30 s (Extend). On an enemy: she awakens already attacking it.
item.isekai_mahou.ranger_warden_chestpla: Forest Warden’s Jerkin and Pelt Mantle
legend.isekai_mahou.ranger_bullet_line_h: The Bullet Line with double Pierce, Piercing Arrow, amplified power and critical: a shot through the whole line.
legend.isekai_mahou.ranger_sacred_purifi: A guided, enlarged and amplified Sacred Arrow: the wave of light cleanses the party and burns the impure.
legend.isekai_mahou.ranger_wolf_goddess_: Calls the pack and awakens the amplified Wolf Goddess: the giant beast of the forest fights by your side.

tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_bow.flavor.0: A walnut recurve bow with eagle-head tips.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_bow.flavor.1: Every feather tied to it is a hunt remembered.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_bow.flavor.2: The green gem pulses when prey is near.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_bow.flavor.3: Ebony and runes: the forest spirit returns some of the arrows.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_bow.flavor.4: Its string is living wind; the beasts answer its snap.

tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_bow.spell: The Grimoire’s Arrow form shoots through this bow.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_garb.beastlo: White alpha pelt and glowing feathers: the beasts bow their heads.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_garb.scout: Tanned leather and wolf pelt: light for the trail, warm for the night watch.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_garb.tracker: Golden eagle feathers stitched to the shoulder: no track escapes.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ranger_garb.warden: Turquoise runes of the old forest whisper where the prey hides.
trail.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.need_cla: Only a Ranger walks the Trail.
